purpose: One date cell of a Calendar: the date on a ghost cell that fills when selected, the band behind a range, and the dash under today or a marked day.

notFor.case: Standalone use outside a month grid.
A cell of an activity or contribution heatmap.

Default.meaning: A day of the month at rest.

Today.visual: A Border/accent edge (Border/strong for secondary) on the cell.

Selected.visual: Cell filled Action/primary/default with Content/on-action (secondary: Surface/inverse with Content/inverse).

RangeStart.meaning: First day of a chosen range.
RangeStart.visual: The Selected cell over the range band (Surface/selected; secondary Surface/muted).

RangeMiddle.meaning: A day inside a chosen range.
RangeMiddle.visual: The range band (Surface/selected; secondary Surface/muted) with the date in Content/accent (secondary Content/primary).

RangeEnd.meaning: Last day of a chosen range.
RangeEnd.visual: The Selected cell over the range band.

Outside.meaning: A day of the previous or next month.

Disabled.visual: Date in Content/disabled; the button is disabled.

Unavailable.meaning: Cannot be picked because it is taken or blocked.
Unavailable.visual: Identical to Disabled: date in Content/disabled, no strike or fill.

Focused.visual: Border/focus edge (secondary Border/strong) with a Border/ring/default halo (secondary Border/subtle).

a11y.keyboard: Reached through the month grid's roving tabindex; Enter or Space selects it (native button).
notes: Its accessible name is the full date when the number alone is not enough.
Disabled and Unavailable both set disabled.
Fill, edge and ink move with use-hover; the halo with use-focus.

openQuestions: Unavailable vs Disabled: they look and behave the same. Should Unavailable differ (a strike, a reason read aloud), or be merged into Disabled?
Today: is today announced to screen readers, or is the edge the only cue?
Reduced motion: should the cell's colour and halo transitions be instant with reduced motion?
